title: 第12章 仙道贵生，予一公
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

白袍修士说起此话，面色坦然，并无愧色。

盖因炼炁大醮早已结束，他为天仓府执事，有权处置府中闲置灵材。

这是他为执事的权利，也是筑基修士应有的特权。

且他并非是妄自取材，而是以【衔光镜砂】换之，并补了一二灵材填充府库，并未贪墨。

也未曾逾矩。

只是他不曾料到，会有人二次大醮得成，再次取材，故此不曾将补偿之物写于宝册之上。

当然，二次大醮也无所谓，关键在于……这新晋弟子，非世家出身，如何得知府中珍藏？

知晓本该有一枚【元火剑砂】？

白袍修士抬首，看向了眼前的岳沉舟。

怕是只有此人了。

岳沉舟心中却是知晓，此事非是自己所为。

但他也并未解释，因为那流光飞符之中已经说了，这弟子刚刚二次大醮得成，选择的灵司是——镇海司。

无需多想，定是林山海师兄的手笔了。

林师兄当是知晓这陆玄择入镇海司，又知晓自己此刻身在天仓府，故此告知了此子【元火剑砂】之事。

若是此子闹起来，自己当为其庇佑一二。

“仙道贵生，泽及万灵，林师兄也是有心了……”

岳沉舟心中一叹。

仙道贵生，这是鉴天教的核心之念，也是仙教创立的根源。

但这四字，时日一长，却有不同之解释。

一派认为，仙道贵生，自然先贵己，己道大成，方才泽生，就算泽生，也应当先家、族、教，后天下。

但还有一派认为，仙道贵生，无量济人。

只要在自身能力范围内，所在疆域之中，当令众生皆得生，岂可罔顾不见？

二派略有分歧，但依旧秉承【贵生】二字，故此倒也不至于有什么大的龌龊，但日常行事，还是能看出差异。

正如林师兄，知晓那新晋弟子本应得【元火剑砂】，所以这才告知其此事，并让其速来天仓府。

而谢师弟大醮结束，直接以执事特权，取走了【元火剑砂】，想要泽及家族后人。

他不能说谢师弟做错了什么，毕竟他身为天仓府执事，确有几分便宜行事的权利。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The white-robed monk said this with a calm face and no shame.

Gai Yin's qi refining ceremony has ended long ago. He is the deacon of Tiancang Mansion and has the authority to dispose of the idle spiritual materials in the manor.

This is his right as a deacon, and it is also the privilege that a foundation-building monk should have.

And he didn't just take the material for himself, but replaced it with [Light Mirror Sand], and added one or two spiritual materials to fill the treasury, and he was not greedy for ink.

Never exceeded the rules.

It's just that he never expected that someone would make the second big ceremony and collect the materials again, so he never wrote the compensation in the treasure book.

Of course, it doesn't matter if there is a second wedding ceremony. The key point is...how does this new disciple, who is not from a noble family, know about the treasures in the mansion?

Do you know that there should be a [Yuanhuo Sword Sand]?

The white-robed monk raised his head and looked at Yue Chenzhou in front of him.

I'm afraid this is the only one.

Yue Chenzhou knew in his heart that he was not responsible for this matter.

But he did not explain, because it was already stated in the Flowing Light Flying Talisman that this disciple had just completed his second great ceremony, and the Spirit Division he chose was - Zhenhai Division.

No need to think too much, it must be the handiwork of Senior Brother Lin Shanhai.

Senior Brother Lin must have known that Lu Xuan had chosen to join Zhenhai Division, and also knew that he was currently in Tiancang Mansion, so he informed him about the [Yuanhuo Sword Sand].

If this kid gets into trouble, I should protect him.

"The precious life of the Immortal Way benefits all souls. Senior Brother Lin is also determined..."

Yue Chenzhou sighed in his heart.

The immortal way and the precious life are the core idea of ​​Jiantian Sect and the root of the creation of the Immortal Sect.

But these four words have different interpretations over time.

One school of thought believes that the immortal way values ​​students, so one must first value oneself, and then one's own path will be greatly accomplished, and only then will talents be born.

But there is another group of people who believe that immortality cherishes life and helps people immeasurably.

As long as it is within the scope of one's ability and within the territory where one is located, all sentient beings should be allowed to live. How can one ignore it?

There are slight differences between the two factions, but they still adhere to the word "Guisheng", so there is no big scandal, but the differences can still be seen in daily actions.

Just like Senior Brother Lin, he knew that the new disciple was supposed to get [Yuanhuo Sword Sand], so he informed him of this and asked him to come to Tiancang Mansion as soon as possible.

After the big ceremony was over, Junior Brother Xie directly took away the [Yuanhuo Sword Sand] with the privilege of being a deacon, hoping to benefit the descendants of the family.

He couldn't say that Junior Brother Xie had done anything wrong. After all, as the deacon of Tiancang Mansion, he did have some rights to act expediently.
